Kathryn Kaminski is chief research strategist and a portfolio manager at AlphaSimplex, an affiliated manager of Virtus Investment Partners. Dr. Kaminski conducts applied research, leads strategic research initiatives, focuses on portfolio construction and risk management, and engages in product development. Dr. Kaminski is a member of the investment committee. Additionally, she serves as a co-portfolio manager for the AlphaSimplex Managed Futures Strategy and AlphaSimplex Global Alternatives Strategy.

Alexander Healy is the chief investment officer and a portfolio manager at AlphaSimplex, an affiliated manager of Virtus Investment Partners. Dr. Healy is responsible for the day-to-day supervision of the research team and the implementation of the firm’s investment strategies. He is the chair of the firm’s investment committee and a member of the operating and risk committees. Additionally, he serves as a co-portfolio manager of certain funds.
